Sunday Social Ride (Conejo Valley Cyclists)

Thousand Oaks, CA · Road · Social

Sunday Social Ride (Conejo Valley Cyclists) is a road and social group ride in Thousand Oaks, CA. It rolls every Sunday at 8:30 am from Von's parking lot on Agoura Rd (the Starbucks corner).

How we know

The club's weekly announcement posted Sept 28, 2026 lists the Sunday Social (no drop) for Oct 4 at 8:30 am, and a Sept 27 notice says the Sunday ride keeps starting from the same Agoura Rd lot now that the Starbucks there has closed (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

For visitors

To get route sheets you must be a member on the weekly announcement list. Visitors and trial riders email the club president first (Contact page on the club site). Helmets and the club's ride-safety rules apply; riders under 18 must ride with a parent. The Starbucks at this start closed in September; the club says the ride keeps starting in the same lot.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: 13+ mph with moderate climbing. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sunday Social Ride (Conejo Valley Cyclists) group ride

A no-drop Sunday loop out of the Agoura Road shopping center, 20 or more miles at 13 mph or better with moderate climbing. The Oct 4 route is 24 miles and about 1,450 feet through Las Flores and Greenmeadow. On alternate Sundays the club also runs a mountain bike ride.
